# Feature flags published in runtimes/nodejs/manifest.json.
#
# This file is the source of truth: scripts/build-nodejs.sh reads it and hands
# the list to generate-metadata.sh at build time. Add a feature here in the same
# change that implements it. Do not edit the list in manifest.json by hand: that
# file is regenerated on every build, so a hand-added entry is lost at the next
# release (which is how v0.4.0 shipped the v0.3.2 feature set).
#
# One feature per line. Blank lines and # comments are ignored.

eval
esm
require
commonjs
filesystem
stdio
env
path
fs
os
process
timers
async
buffer
events
util
assert
stream
url
crypto
structured-clone
querystring
string-decoder
fs-promises
timers-promises
zlib-stub
worker-threads-stub
child-process-stub
process-module
tty
stdin
node-test
exports-map
named-stack-frames

# A node-shaped console (error/warn/table/...) and process lifecycle: process is
# an EventEmitter, uncaught errors and unhandled rejections exit 1 unless a
# listener takes them, and a drained loop emits 'exit' with process.exitCode.
console
process-events
unhandled-rejections
exit-code

# Inbound only: Preview 1 can accept, read and write a socket handed in by the
# host, but cannot open one, so the client halves report themselves unsupported.
net-server
http-server
https-stub
dgram-stub
tls-stub

# Native hashing (md5, sha1, sha224, sha256, sha384, sha512) in C, HMAC and
# PBKDF2 over it, and subtle.digest.
native-hashes
pbkdf2
# AsyncLocalStorage and AsyncResource, carried across awaits by the engine.
async-hooks
# process.memoryUsage(), uptime(), hrtime.bigint() and 'beforeExit'.
process-metrics
before-exit
# package.json "imports" (#name specifiers).
package-imports
# Headers, Request, Response, AbortController, EventTarget as globals. fetch
# itself needs outbound connect, so it is in features-net.txt.
web-fetch-types
abort-controller
